title: Paired input encoding
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $r$ be a finite Boolean list, and let $v$ be a Boolean assignment on the $n$ input indices. The paired input encoding on $2n+2+|r|$ positions evaluates the paired wire assignment using $v$ for input wires and the specified values for constant wires.
